issues.rationale: The template root is operator configuration from TEMPLATES_DIR, not a request parameter (src/configuration_paths.ts:5-6; src/backup.ts:456-463). A root link is rejected at backup_generation.ts:197-198; readdir names come from the filesystem; entry links are rejected, member segments reject traversal and separators, and depth, entry count and byte limits apply at lines 160-175 and 200-209. The actual Compose configuration assigns /app/templates to a named volume used only by the forwarder (docker-compose.yml:33,37-46). No separate lower-trust writer to that volume was identified in the supported Compose topology.
issues.limitation: This is not a filesystem sandbox. A separate hostile actor with write/symlink access to templates could swap a nested directory between Dirent inspection and recursive read, or a file between lstatSync and readFileSync. Coherent backup inclusion would require winning or sustaining the race across the later source-coherence pass (backup_generation.ts:269-288,394-413); no exploit has been demonstrated. A custom shared/bind mount or distinct local writer requires fresh review.
